parsed.why: Facility ban extended to colleges in 2026, freeze-frame prison treatment policy, no hate-crime statute; enforcement partly enjoined, no division arrest. Escalating but not harshest tier, so slightly below the restrictive parent.

Comprehensive birth-sex facility ban reaching airports, parks and government buildings with criminal-trespass exposure, driver's licence fraud rule, state travel advisory and Do-Not-Travel label plus elevated trans homicide rate: deeper than parent.

Statewide gender-identity accommodations and hate-crime law, sanctuary statute, facilities by identity, trans-panic defence abolished. Parent border/document regime still binds at entry, and two recent trans killings keep it from the low-risk band.

Most-protective tier: 1993 non-discrimination, hate-crime coverage, care shield, open ID markers, conversion ban. Only dated 2012 birth-sex custody record offsets; parent entry-document regime still applies to every arriving visitor.

Harshest-tier 2026 licence-marker ban and barred certificate changes are mostly resident-facing; no facility ban in force, bathroom bill died, hate-crime law covers gender identity. Parent border regime dominates, so near parent rating.
